fields.description: ENARA is OMNIYAT’s commercial development on Marasi Bay, designed by Gensler. Grand and Ultra-Grand offices are offered as shell and core, with landscaped terraces and space-planning options. Meeting facilities, a spa, fitness spaces and a private members’ club form part of the proposed workplace offering.
